common_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Asset: professional anime female CHIBI orthographic character turnaround, exactly three full-body views on one 1536x1024 landscape white sheet. INPUT IMAGE 1 is the authoritative eight-character front-reference board. Select ONLY the character specified below; recreate her front as faithfully as possible, then rotate the SAME complete design to a strict 90-degree LEFT SIDE profile (nose points left) and a direct BACK view. The specific board character's face, eye color, bangs, hair length, body proportions, garment silhouette, neckline, layers, trims, accessories and shoes are the design authority. This is a NEW 'dance reference' variant, not a restoration of an older costume. Preserve what is actually in the board. All three figures must have identical height, head size, body proportions, costume construction and accessory positions in character-space. Her anatomical left side remains her left when rotated. No perspective or three-quarter pose. Side shows only one eye; back shows no face or eyes. All figures relaxed standing, both feet flat, arms slightly apart and hands empty. Do not add fan, flute, axe or handheld book. Existing worn waist ornaments remain.
LAYOUT: single title at top center with character name. Three evenly spaced columns, left FRONT / middle LEFT SIDE / right BACK, all head tops and shoe soles aligned on the same subtle light-gray baseline, with generous clean margins around hair, ears, sleeves, wings and tail. No overlap or cropping. Below each figure add simple uppercase sans-serif labels exactly "FRONT", "LEFT SIDE", "BACK". White background, no grid, no panel borders, no dimensions, no color palette or extra portraits. Clean crisp anime outlines and soft controlled cel shading matching the eight-person reference board; small gold ornaments legible but not over-detailed. Keep the selected reference's open eyes with visible iris/pupil, tiny closed mouth, subtle blush. No drool, blank eyes, open mouth, tongue, tears, wink, grin or extra characters. Conservatively infer unseen side/back clothing structures. Maintain physical consistency of head decorations, sleeves, book/pouch straps, wings and tail attachments. Other characters visible in the board must NOT appear in the output or donate their features.

characters.name: DeepSeek
characters.details: Blue whale girl. Deep navy-blue hair with light-blue wavy ends reaching below the waist, forward ahoge, whale side fins instead of cat ears, white frilled maid headband and two little blue hair bows. Bright blue eyes and tiny closed omega smile. Navy-and-white short maid dress with puffy long sleeves, white cuffs, white bib/apron with small navy whale motif, dark waist belt with gold buttons, white ruffled skirt layers, white knee socks, navy Mary Jane shoes. Large blue whale tail emerges once from lower back and curves to HER LEFT (viewer-right in FRONT, viewer-left in BACK), matching the board. Exactly one tail and two side fin ears; no animal cat ears or horns. Back apron ties are a modest white bow inferred from the front apron, kept beneath the hair; do not enlarge or redesign the dress.

characters.name: Qwen
characters.details: Periwinkle/lavender-blue long wavy hair with a thick braid on HER LEFT chest, purple eyes, tiny relaxed closed smile. Small tilted navy beret with white ruffle and gold-edged flower emblem on HER RIGHT side of head. Cream Chinese-style high-collar center dress with gold frog closures; short layered blue skirt; blue-purple wide-sleeve open robe with gold borders and blue tassels, matching the board's SHORT chibi outfit. Tiny matching cream-and-blue gold-chain pouch at HER LEFT waist, gold dangling earrings, blue shoes with flower badges and white ankle ruffles. Empty hands, NO fan. No ears, tail or wings. The thick front braid must stay on HER LEFT, not swap sides in profile.

characters.name: Kimi
characters.details: Silver-white fluffy long hair with pale lavender ends and loose wavy sections, lavender eyes, tiny shy closed smile. White ruffled headband and crescent-moon/navy ribbon ornament at HER LEFT temple. Ornate small navy-and-gold throat bow, white ruffled blouse, short navy shoulder cape with gold stars and crescent motifs, navy/cream short layered ruffle dress and fine gold celestial trim, tiny gold chains/book charm attached at HER LEFT waist, navy shoes with white lace ankle socks. Match THIS board's neckline, bow and dress; do not substitute another long-skirt Kimi design. No flute, no rainbow beam, no handheld book, no ears or tail.

characters.name: GLM
characters.details: Straight black long hair with slight cool-purple shadows and blunt bangs, gray-violet eyes, earnest gently deadpan expression with a very small closed nearly horizontal mouth. White ruffled headband; black-and-white ribbon with a white Z plate at HER LEFT temple. Modest white blouse with puffy long sleeves, small black collar bow, black-and-white layered short scholar-maid dress, small gold/silver trims and chain details, white lace-up boots with black toe caps. A SMALL closed black book with gold edges and tiny light emblem hangs at HER RIGHT waist on a short attachment as in the board, NOT in her hand; empty visible hands. Do not introduce fox ears, tail, hat, weapons or a different GLM costume.

characters.name: GPT
characters.details: White-lavender dragon girl with white long layered hair and ahoge, pale lavender ribbed dragon horns, pointed ears, knotted white hair ornament with tassel at HER LEFT temple, two small pale-lavender dragon wings and ONE pale-lavender scaly dragon tail. Soft lavender eyes with visible iris/pupil and slightly relaxed upper lids, tiny confident closed smile, absolutely no blank eyes or drool. White and pale lavender sleeveless high-neck Chinese-inspired asymmetric short dress with long flowing back panels, detached small bell sleeves, knot-shaped waist jewelry and tassels, matching white-lavender boots. Tail curves toward HER RIGHT (viewer-left in FRONT) as in the board. Precisely preserve the board's chibi skirt, neckline and detached sleeves. Keep face naturally pleasant in FRONT and LEFT SIDE.

characters.name: Claude
characters.details: Long wavy copper-orange hair, amber eyes, tiny warm closed smile, orange flower and black ribbon at HER LEFT temple. IMPORTANT: use the BOARD's NEW outfit: an open/off-shoulder neckline with a small dark neck ribbon and gold flower, white puffy long sleeves, black fitted bodice and a prominent black-and-gold waist bow; cream short layered ruffle skirt with tangerine triangular panels, black lower accents, orange botanical trim and flower accents, cream lace-up ankle boots. There is NO shoulder cape in this board variant; do NOT add the older cream shoulder cape, high ruffle collar, or handheld book. Keep the outfit tasteful and doll-like exactly as the reference. Back dress fastenings and waist-bow construction inferred modestly; no giant new bow, no animal ears or tail.

characters.name: Gemini
characters.details: Blue-purple fluffy long hair fading to pink/lilac ends, two small hair buns, real cat ears with pink inner fur, an ahoge; iridescent four-point star hair ornament at HER LEFT temple. Heterochromia is CRITICAL: HER RIGHT eye magenta = FRONT viewer-left; HER LEFT eye GOLD = FRONT viewer-right. LEFT SIDE exposes HER LEFT eye, therefore the SINGLE VISIBLE PROFILE EYE MUST BE GOLD, with the star ornament visible on that near side. Tiny closed omega smile. Navy/purple and white cropped fantasy kimono top with white ruffles, detached long draped bell sleeves, short purple layered skirt, gold star trimmings and star jewels, chunky purple-blue shoes and white ruffled ankle socks. Exactly ONE fluffy blue-purple cat tail emerges from lower back and curves toward HER LEFT (FRONT viewer-right), coherent in all views. No floating star particles, no weapons, no extra limbs.

characters.name: Grok
characters.details: Long blonde wavy high twin-tails tied with black/gold bows, blue eyes and subtle cheeky CLOSED omega smile. Tiny black-and-gold crown and pointed ears. Small black bat wings from the upper back, matching reference; exactly two wings. Black gothic short layered high-low dress with burgundy lining, gold filigree, gold ring-and-chain waist details, burgundy high neck ribbon with round brooch, puffy upper sleeves and detached black bell sleeves, dark knee socks, black gold-buckle shoes. Preserve the board's full costume and twin-tail volume, no axe or any weapon anywhere on this new sheet, no tail, no visible fang or open mouth. Side shows her hair and wing positions accurately; back wings do not swap into a new shape.
